text: Implemented the remaining acceptance scope on disk. Added scheduler-neutral remote-exec-kernel AtomicFiles mechanics; kept scala-slurm-worker AtomicFiles as a source-compatible ContentDigest facade; moved local script staging from create-final-then-write to locked CREATE_NEW temp, private permissions, force(true), and ATOMIC_MOVE; made stable writes deterministic under concurrent identical and divergent writers; fixed a claim TOCTOU loser misclassification. Evidence: kernel AtomicFiles suite 7/7, repeated five times for race stability; local 17/17; worker 29/29; full sbt checkFormatting test green across the dirty live checkout.
